title: 19 MINUTE SOLO NEX (OSRS)
summary: Gnomonkey completes a solo Nex kill in under 20 minutes, about 19 minutes, improving his earlier 26:30 time. He says his setup is about as refined as it can get and discusses weapons, difficulty and what a faster time would need. The video is mostly live commentary over gameplay.

outline.text: Stream chatter and start of the run
Chat questions on weapons: Void Waker, DDS, claws
Talk of solo Nex drops and KC, tbow damage on P2
Leech spawn and ice prison/blood sacrifice phases
Prison roll, Glacies dying fast, tick eating
Sub-20 finish and discussion of sub-19 and sub-18

claims.text: Gnomonkey killed Nex solo in under 20 minutes, with the description saying it was close to 19 minutes, smashing his previous time.
Gnomonkey considers solo Nex on par in difficulty with solo Theatre of Blood, because it requires perfect control of movement and reacting to Nex's random movements is very challenging.
Gnomonkey says solo Nex is not worth it for money, but it is still over 10m GP/hr even with sweet usage, assuming consistent KC.
Gnomonkey says the hardest part of solo Nex is tick eating perfectly and adapting to weird distance dashes.
Gnomonkey says his solo Nex setup is as refined as it can get, with the optimal amount of brew and restore, and that packing a ZCB or additional switches is not worth the inventory slots.
Gnomonkey says tbow camping on phase 2 of Nex is painful but seems the best option unless something new is discovered.
In phase 5 of Nex, anything where you do not have to start tick eating is very good, according to Gnomonkey.
Gnomonkey credits the advice 'don't die' for the sub-20 solo Nex time, noting that phase 2 was slow but phases 3 and 4 were very fast.
Gnomonkey thinks a sub-19 solo Nex is definitely possible but would be rare, and a sub-18 is probably technically possible but would be about the end of the line.
At the time of the video, Gnomonkey says no one had received a solo Nex drop, and he would like to be the first, which is why he still goes for KC.
Gnomonkey considers a 25 a pretty low roll for Nex's ice prison, and notes Glacies dying really fast in that kill.
Gnomonkey says a dragon dagger (DDS) is better than claws for solo Nex.
Gnomonkey states the dragon dagger special has a max of 110, while the Voidwaker's max is only around 80.
Gnomonkey achieved a solo Nex kill of just under 20 minutes in February 2024, improving on his earlier 26:30 time.
Gnomonkey says he would love a solo Nex pet and that getting a solo pet would make him lose it and quit streaming.
Gnomonkey streams his speedrun attempts and answers viewer questions during runs, such as whether Voidwaker is needed and whether DDS beats claws.
Gnomonkey says the Voidwaker has a max hit of only about 80 on its special, compared with 110 for a dragon dagger special.
Gnomonkey jokes that an Iron Man should not have to grind bosses just to get a Voidwaker to click a blue orb for 23 damage.
Gnomonkey used his Voidwaker on a late attempt at the sub-20 solo Nex kill, saying he wanted to go for it really badly.
